description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: Ensures idempotence. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. The ClientToken value must contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

title.zh: 更新一个凭据基本信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-credential --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --credential-id cred_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --credential-name credential_name --credential-content '{"ApiKeyContent":{"ApiKey":"nsklnertyt5ddwizncxxxx"},"OAuthClientContent":{"ClientSecret":"nsklncmwizncxxxx","ClientId":"dmvncmxersdxxxxxx"}}' --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateCredential --region cn-hangzhou --CredentialContent.ApiKeyContent.ApiKey nsklnertyt5ddwizncxxxx --CredentialContent.OAuthClientContent.ClientId dmvncmxersdxxxxxx --CredentialId cred_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --CredentialName credential_name --CredentialContent.OAuthClientContent.ClientSecret nsklncmwizncxxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --method POST --force
